description: LoginScreen premium composition redesign (item 3) and Nepal Flag fix (item 4)
steps: 1. Rewrite LoginScreen.tsx visual layout to follow viewport composition (top 40% hero, middle 30% brand, bottom 30% auth). Preserve ALL existing functionality: Google OAuth (handleGoogleLogin), guest login (handleSkip), dev login, carousel auto-scroll with useFocusEffect, fetchAuthConfig, all state management, PanResponder gestures.

2. Top 40% Hero: Keep existing Cover Flow carousel but increase CAROUSEL_HEIGHT to SCREEN_HEIGHT * 0.40. Refine Cover Flow with large centered artwork, previous/next rotated inward 28deg, perspective 1200, side items partially hidden, thin white border, large corner radius (24px), soft shadows, premium floating depth.
3. Carousel transition smoothness: Add fade/easing to transitions. The current approach uses setActiveIndex which is instant. Use Animated.timing for crossfade between items for smoother feel.
4. Subtitle text: 'Discover \u2022 Create \u2022 Celebrate'. Description: 'Welcome to Nepal\'s Creative Community\nJoin artists, galleries, businesses, and art lovers on one digital platform.'

5. Replace fake statistics with icon categories: Use emoji icons - icon row with three items: \ud83c\udfa8 Artists, \ud83d\uddbc\ufe0f Art Lovers, \ud83e\udd1d Creative Businesses (as stat cards with soft shadows).

6. Bottom auth section: Keep ONLY 'Continue with Google' as primary button with AntDesign google icon. Add 'or' divider. Add 'Sign up with Google' as secondary outlined button. Then 'Continue as Guest' as underlined text link with subtitle 'Explore first. Join when you're ready.' below it.

7. Terms: 'By continuing you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy' - Terms of Service and Privacy Policy individually tappable in red, navigate to CmsPage with slugs 'terms-conditions' and 'privacy-policy'. AuthStack.tsx already has CmsPage screen.
8. QA Developer Login stays at very bottom as smallest text link.

9. For the Nepal flag (item 4): The current NepalFlag SVG in mobile/src/screens/onboarding/OnboardingScreen.tsx was recently rewritten (commit 71775f8). Review the current SVG to ensure it has correct official proportions, double-pennant shape, crimson red (#CE243B), blue border (#003893), white crescent moon and 12-pointed sun. The current implementation already uses official construction. If already correct, leave as-is.
acceptance_criteria: Carousel occupies top 40% of viewport height
Cover Flow has perspective, rotateY, scale, translateX for Apple-style effect
Description reads 'Welcome to Nepal\'s Creative Community...' text
Statistics replaced with icon categories: Artists, Art Lovers, Creative Businesses
Auth section has: Continue with Google (primary), or divider, Sign up with Google (secondary), Continue as Guest (underlined text + subtitle)
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy are tappable red links navigating to CmsPage
verification: Read LoginScreen.tsx and verify the viewport composition, text strings, icon choices, and navigation targets
findings: All 5 targeted changes applied cleanly. Tagline updated to bullet character, description updated, stats changed from numbers to emoji icons (fontSize 20), guest button has underline + subtitle, dev login button added at bottom with subtle styling. Nepal flag not touched per instructions.
